facts.activity_file: removing isolation and returning to operations

control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of kinetic energy at CV-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on CV-3100 and M-3100 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. CV-3100 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 4 May 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on CV-3100 and M-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
